verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੀਵੈ ਥੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਾ ਵਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau beseevai theh kar pachhotaavai sukh naa vasai|

en.bdb: Inhabiting in other's lands brings repentence and takes away happiness;

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਚੜਿ ਲੜਦੇ ਭੂਮੀਏ ਧਾੜਾ ਪੇੜਾ ਖਸਣ ਖਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: chaR chaR laRadhe bhoome'ee dhaaRaa peRaa khasan khasai|

en.bdb: Daily the land lords quarrel, toot and extort.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹ ਨਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਦੂਲਹਾ ਦੁਹ ਮੁਨਸਾ ਦੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਵਿਣਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhuh naaree dhaa dhoolahaa dhuh munasaa dhee naar vinasai|

en.bdb: Husband of two women and the wife of two husbands are bound to perish;

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਇ ਉਜਾੜਾ ਖੇਤੀਐ ਦੁਹਿ ਹਾਕਮ ਦੁਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਖੁਣਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: hui ujaaRaa kheteeaai dhuh haakam dhui hukam khunasai|

en.bdb: Tillage under the orders of two mutually antagonist masters would go waste.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਦੁਇ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਛਿਜੈ ਵੈਰਾਇਣੁ ਹਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhukh dhui chi(n)taa raat dhih ghar chhijai vairain hasai|

en.bdb: Where suffering and anxiety dwell day and night i.e. all the time, that house gets destroyed and the neighbourhood women laugh derisively.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੁ ਖੁੰਢਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਵਸਦੀ ਵਸੈ ਨ ਨਸਦੀ ਨਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhuh khu(n)ddaa(n) vich rakh sir vasadhee vasai na nasadhee nasai|

en.bdb: If one gets one's head stuck in two cavities, one can neither stay nor run away.
Likewise, the sense of duality is a virtual snake-bite.
